# LoginUrlInfo

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.LoginUrlInfo`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(*, client: 'pyrogram.Client' = None): ...
```

## Documentation

Information about an inline button of type [`LoginUrl`](LoginUrl.md) or about an external link,
returned by [`get_login_url_info`](../../methods/bots/get_login_url_info.md) and [`get_external_link_info`](../../methods/auth/get_external_link_info.md).

It should be one of:

- [`LoginUrlInfoOpen`](LoginUrlInfoOpen.md)
- [`LoginUrlInfoRequestConfirmation`](LoginUrlInfoRequestConfirmation.md)
